definitions.gloss: suppuration; festering; becoming infected with pus
definitions.explanation: The formation of pus in a wound or infected area. A medical term used in both clinical and everyday contexts when a wound becomes infected.

examples.japanese: {傷|きず}が{化膿|かのう}してしまった。
{化膿|かのう}を{防|ふせ}ぐために{消毒|しょうどく}した。
examples.english: I disinfected it to prevent infection.

examples.japanese: {傷口|きずぐち}が{化膿|かのう}して{赤|あか}く{腫|は}れてきたので、{病院|びょういん}に{行|い}くことにした。
examples.english: The wound festered and became red and swollen, so I decided to go to the hospital.

notes:
USAGE:
{化膿|かのう} is used both as a medical term and in everyday conversation when describing infected wounds. It is commonly used with する to form a verb.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {傷|きず}が{化膿|かのう}する (a wound festers)
- {化膿|かのう}を{防|ふせ}ぐ (to prevent infection)
- {化膿|かのう}{止|ど}め (antiseptic — prevents suppuration)
- {化膿|かのう}{性|せい} (purulent, suppurative)

MEDICAL CONTEXT:
A doctor might say {化膿|かのう}しています (it's infected) when examining a wound. Over-the-counter {化膿|かのう}{止|ど}め (antiseptic) products are commonly available at pharmacies.
